decisions.statement: A body the change has is written at the path the change files that body at.
A path the change takes away is written by nothing.
A mirror has nothing beyond the bodies the change has.
No body reaches a mirror from the tree the mirror is made beside.
A tool reading a mirror follows no path out of the mirror by itself.
A mirror sits under `/var/tmp` rather than `/tmp`.
A mirror is swept by the caller that asked for the mirror.
A mirror that could not be made is swept and reaches no caller.
A body that would not be read names the path that body was handed in for.
Nothing here runs a tool over the bodies the mirror holds.
Nothing here links a path into the mirror.
Which paths a mirror is written over is settled by the caller that asked.

definition: a folder with the bodies a change has, each at the path it is filed at
